Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

The same Blood Wave loop as the class's meta build, re-cut for a character that will never hold a Mythic and does not want to lean on a bug. Two things drive every change here. First, the base build's progression is written around crafting Ring of Starless Skies: it is what drops the Resource Cost Reduction requirement from over 25% to over 15%, and until it lands the build is resource-starved. In Season 14's Solo Self-Found mode there is no trading to shortcut that, so this variant is written to be playable without the ring: Essence Regeneration and Resource Cost Reduction stay at the front of every jewelry priority for the whole run and the base guide's pre-ring 25% Resource Cost Reduction gate is treated as permanent. The ring is still drawn on the late-endgame and push rows because the gear model here is the base build's own planner payload and that payload equips it; the difference is that no advice on this page leans on it. Second, the base build's endgame survivability package is Embattled Aspect plus Endurant Faith, and its own guide says in writing that the instant fortify healing this relies on 'is a bug'. That is the single most nerf-exposed thing in the Season 14 build set, so it comes out and Aspect of Disobedience takes the slot - less effective, and it will still be there after the next hotfix. The trade is honest: this is a slower, squishier, more resource-gated Blood Wave that survives a patch. Play the meta build instead if you have the Mythics.

Rotation
  1. Open on a small pull and cast Blood Wave until Resolve is around 10, then push.
  2. Steady state: Blood Lance from range before every pack, Bone Prison before contact, Corpse Tendrils for Vulnerable, Blood Mist every eight seconds, and Blood Wave held down.
Variants

Leveling — Unchanged from the base build: Sever onto a pack, which drops a corpse; Blood Mist eats it for Flesh Eater and teleports you again; Blood Lance from range to dump Overpower, then hold Blood Wave to regain it; Bone Prison on anything that survives; weave Reap when Essence runs dry. Expect to weave Reap far more often than the base guide implies - that is what not owning the ring feels like.
Move on when Kessime's Legacy equipped. Everything else on this page is optional; that is not.

Early Endgame — The loop runs itself from here: the Wat rune applies Decrepify, Life Tap generates Blood Orbs, and the Teb rune spends them on Iron Maiden for Vulnerable. Rotate Sever and Blood Mist for movement and otherwise hold Blood Wave, with Bone Prison on anything tanky.
Move on when Banished Lord's Talisman on the amulet and the three greater-affix Lucky Hit restore tempers landed on your jewelry. In the base build this stage ends when you craft Ring of Starless Skies; here the tempers are the substitute and they are strictly worse, which is the point of the variant.

Late Endgame — Identical to the early endgame. What changes is the gear, not the gameplay - and here that means one aspect swap, not two: Disobedience onto the boots and nothing onto the bug.
Move on when Comfortable at Torment 4 with the 25% Resource Cost Reduction floor held and Aspect of Redirected Force ready to go on the block-chance rebuild.

Pushing — Read the base guide's warning first, because it kills characters: Decrepify is how Resolve stacks are generated, and you start a Pit run with none. Open on a small pull, cast Blood Wave until Resolve is around 10, then push. Steady state: Blood Lance from range before every pack, Bone Prison before contact, Corpse Tendrils for Vulnerable and Flesh Eater, Blood Mist every eight seconds, Blood Wave held down. Without Blood-Mad Idol, packs take longer and you have more room to make a mistake in - play to that.

Blood Wave Necromancer - Maxroll Light / Medium / Strict (in-guide import codes) — View Filter

maxroll.gg

Same three in-guide import codes the base build uses, because the affix pool is the same one. Use the Light tier rather than Strict here: this variant deliberately never crafts a Mythic, so it needs to keep seeing the Legendary jewelry and the Essence-regeneration rolls a Strict endgame filter hides. Preview the code before importing.

Uniques
  • pants The build's enabler and the only item here that is not optional - it fires two waves per cast and pulls monsters into them. Gamble pants at the vendor, and target-farm Andariel (Hanged Man's Hall, east of Tarsarak, Kehjistan; 1x Greater Lair Key, keys from Initiate lair bosses). The plain Unique is fine; this variant never upgrades it. Where →
  • amulet General Unique Pool, so any lair boss can drop it - which is exactly why it is the one special amulet this variant chases: it needs no Horadric Cube conversion and no Mythic. Run whichever Initiate lair boss you already have keys for. Where →
  • ring 1 Mythic Unique. Rare drop from any lair boss, or a Horadric Cube craft with Pandemonium Fragments - remembering that only one Cube-crafted Mythic can be equipped at a time. It is listed because the gear model this variant inherits equips it at the last two stages, not because the variant needs it: every stat gate on this page is the base guide's pre-ring number. Where →

How to run them

The base build's own guide hires Aldkin while gearing, for the 15% Critical Strike Chance and the early sustain, and switches to Subo from the midgame for map visibility and a 25% Critical Damage multiplier. That switch is a bet that crit chance has been solved by gear, and without Mythics it has not been, so this variant simply never makes it. The Reinforcement is unchanged and is the part every source agrees on: Raheir on Bastion, whose picks are inherited from the base build unchanged. The hire's picks are not inherited and could not be: the base build's planner payload records Subo's tree, not Aldkin's, and no source publishes an Aldkin allocation for a Necromancer. So the two recorded above are the two that can be stated without inventing anything - his Perk, which is granted to every hire rather than chosen, and the one Aldkin skill the knowledge base names anywhere. Treat the rest of his tree as open, and read the base build's page for the Subo allocation if you take the midgame switch after all.

Plan

Said plainly: this is an activity-level allocation, not a per-build one. No guide for this build publishes War Plan picks - the Season 14 planner payload behind the base build carries no War Plans data at all, and every War Plans guide in existence organises its advice per activity rather than per build. So the picks below are Maxroll's build-agnostic endgame progression priorities, tagged with the activity that owns each node, and they are the same nine any Season 14 character would take first. No `level` is recorded because no source publishes an order: the feed carries no per-node level and a planner stores a plan as an unordered set.

What is lit9 picks recorded on 5 of 7 activities. Everything else is dimmed, not ruled out: the trees below are the game's own 100 nodes, and a War Plan is per character.
Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

The same Blood Wave loop as the class's meta build, re-cut for a character that will never hold a Mythic and does not want to lean on a bug. Two things drive every change here. First, the base build's progression is written around crafting Ring of Starless Skies: it is what drops the Resource Cost Reduction requirement from over 25% to over 15%, and until it lands the build is resource-starved. In Season 14's Solo Self-Found mode there is no trading to shortcut that, so this variant is written to be playable without the ring: Essence Regeneration and Resource Cost Reduction stay at the front of every jewelry priority for the whole run and the base guide's pre-ring 25% Resource Cost Reduction gate is treated as permanent. The ring is still drawn on the late-endgame and push rows because the gear model here is the base build's own planner payload and that payload equips it; the difference is that no advice on this page leans on it. Second, the base build's endgame survivability package is Embattled Aspect plus Endurant Faith, and its own guide says in writing that the instant fortify healing this relies on 'is a bug'. That is the single most nerf-exposed thing in the Season 14 build set, so it comes out and Aspect of Disobedience takes the slot - less effective, and it will still be there after the next hotfix. The trade is honest: this is a slower, squishier, more resource-gated Blood Wave that survives a patch. Play the meta build instead if you have the Mythics.

Rotation
  1. Open on a small pull and cast Blood Wave until Resolve is around 10, then push.
  2. Steady state: Blood Lance from range before every pack, Bone Prison before contact, Corpse Tendrils for Vulnerable, Blood Mist every eight seconds, and Blood Wave held down.
Variants

Leveling — Unchanged from the base build: Sever onto a pack, which drops a corpse; Blood Mist eats it for Flesh Eater and teleports you again; Blood Lance from range to dump Overpower, then hold Blood Wave to regain it; Bone Prison on anything that survives; weave Reap when Essence runs dry. Expect to weave Reap far more often than the base guide implies - that is what not owning the ring feels like.
Move on when Kessime's Legacy equipped. Everything else on this page is optional; that is not.

Early Endgame — The loop runs itself from here: the Wat rune applies Decrepify, Life Tap generates Blood Orbs, and the Teb rune spends them on Iron Maiden for Vulnerable. Rotate Sever and Blood Mist for movement and otherwise hold Blood Wave, with Bone Prison on anything tanky.
Move on when Banished Lord's Talisman on the amulet and the three greater-affix Lucky Hit restore tempers landed on your jewelry. In the base build this stage ends when you craft Ring of Starless Skies; here the tempers are the substitute and they are strictly worse, which is the point of the variant.

Late Endgame — Identical to the early endgame. What changes is the gear, not the gameplay - and here that means one aspect swap, not two: Disobedience onto the boots and nothing onto the bug.
Move on when Comfortable at Torment 4 with the 25% Resource Cost Reduction floor held and Aspect of Redirected Force ready to go on the block-chance rebuild.

Pushing — Read the base guide's warning first, because it kills characters: Decrepify is how Resolve stacks are generated, and you start a Pit run with none. Open on a small pull, cast Blood Wave until Resolve is around 10, then push. Steady state: Blood Lance from range before every pack, Bone Prison before contact, Corpse Tendrils for Vulnerable and Flesh Eater, Blood Mist every eight seconds, Blood Wave held down. Without Blood-Mad Idol, packs take longer and you have more room to make a mistake in - play to that.

Uniques
  • pants The build's enabler and the only item here that is not optional - it fires two waves per cast and pulls monsters into them. Gamble pants at the vendor, and target-farm Andariel (Hanged Man's Hall, east of Tarsarak, Kehjistan; 1x Greater Lair Key, keys from Initiate lair bosses). The plain Unique is fine; this variant never upgrades it. Where →
  • amulet General Unique Pool, so any lair boss can drop it - which is exactly why it is the one special amulet this variant chases: it needs no Horadric Cube conversion and no Mythic. Run whichever Initiate lair boss you already have keys for. Where →
  • ring 1 Mythic Unique. Rare drop from any lair boss, or a Horadric Cube craft with Pandemonium Fragments - remembering that only one Cube-crafted Mythic can be equipped at a time. It is listed because the gear model this variant inherits equips it at the last two stages, not because the variant needs it: every stat gate on this page is the base guide's pre-ring number. Where →

Reasoning

Based onBlood Wave Necromancer
Tweaks vs. the base build
  1. The progression stops assuming Ring of Starless Skies. It is still shown on the late-endgame and push rows, because this variant inherits the base build's planner payload for its gear model and that payload equips it - saying otherwise would misdescribe the page. What changes is that nothing below depends on it: the base guide relaxes its Resource Cost Reduction gate from over 25% to over 15% the moment the ring lands, and this variant holds 25% for the whole run so the character is playable without it. Treat the ring as a bonus, not a milestone.
  2. Essence Regeneration and Resource Cost Reduction lead the ring and amulet priorities at every stage, not just the early ones. The base build relaxes Resource Cost Reduction to over 15% once the Mythic ring lands; with no ring the guide's own earlier gate - over 25% - stays in force to the end.
  3. Embattled Aspect is dropped from the late-endgame boots. Tidal Aspect takes the boots (the base guide's own push placement) and Aspect of Disobedience is transfigured onto the amulet, since Disobedience is a defensive aspect and cannot sit on boots. The base guide states outright that 'Embattled Aspect makes your fortify healing instant (it is a bug)'. Disobedience's stacking armour is worse and is not a patch target.
  4. The push stage keeps Banished Lord's Talisman on the amulet instead of swapping to Blood-Mad Idol. Blood-Mad Idol is the base build's damage-over-survivability trade and it is also a Mythic; both reasons point the same way here.
  5. Aldkin is hired rather than Subo. Maxroll's own guide hires Aldkin 'especially during the early game' for the 15% Critical Strike Chance and switches to Subo from the midgame - a switch that assumes the crit chance has been solved by gear. Without Mythics it has not been, so the gearing-stage hire stays hired.
  6. Adds an explicit War Plans allocation, which the base build does not carry: its planner payload has no War Plans data. The picks are Maxroll's build-agnostic activity priorities and the war_plans summary says so.

  • OverpowerCasting Blood Wave overfills your Overpower by 2.
  • HematolagniaBlood Wave becomes a Core Skill, has no Cooldown, but costs 50 Essence. Blood Wave conjures a shorter wave that deals 300% damage and no longer Knocks Back enemies.
  • Damage BonusBlood Wave deals 30%[x] increased damage while you are Fortified.
Physical Damage

Blood Lance

CoreBlood

Rank 1/15

Essence Cost: 15

Lucky Hit Chance: 50%

Throw a blood lance, dealing 130% to an enemy that ricochets to another enemy. Enemies hit are lanced for 3 seconds.

When Blood Lance hits an enemy, it deals damage to all other lanced enemies.

Modifiers

  • OverpowerBlood Lance consumes 2 stacks of Overpower to throw an additional lance, dealing 50% of normal damage.
  • FortifyBlood Lance Fortifies you for 4% of your Maximum Life ({x}) if it hits an enemy already lanced.
  • Festering WoundBlood Lance becomes a Darkness Skill and deals Shadow damage. Enemies hit are permanently lanced and the lance deals 80% Corrupting damage per second to them.
Physical Damage

Sever

CoreShadow

Rank 1/15

Essence Cost: 20

Lucky Hit Chance: 40%

A specter of you charges forward, dealing 60% damage, then attacks with its scythe, dealing 100% damage.

Modifiers

  • Cost ReductionSever's Essence cost is reduced by 4.
  • Inexorable ReaperSever is also a Mobility Skill that dashes you forward to attack instead.
  • Crowd Control and Corpse GenerationSever Slows enemies by 40% for 3 seconds and forms a Corpse.
Shadow Damage

Bone Prison

MacabreBone

Rank 15/15

Cooldown: 15 seconds

Unearth a prison of bone with {x} Life that surrounds the target area for 6 seconds.

Modifiers

  • Essence GenerationCasting Bone Prison generates 50 Essence. Trapping a Boss generates an additional 25 Essence.
  • Life ImprisonmentBone Prison becomes a Blood Skill, casting the prison around you. While standing within it your Essence Generation and Cast Speed are increased by 20%, but it drains 5% of your Maximum Life every second.
  • VulnerableBone Prison makes enemies Vulnerable for 8 seconds.

Blood Mist

MacabreBlood

Rank 1/15

Cooldown: 24 seconds

Lucky Hit Chance: 9%

Disperse into a bloody mist, becoming Immune for 3 seconds. You deal 420% damage to enemies and Heal for 6.0% of your Maximum Life ({x}) over the duration.

Modifiers

  • Movement SpeedBlood Mist increases your Movement Speed by 30%[x] for 3 seconds.
  • Blood RushBlood Mist is now also a Mobility Skill and its Cooldown is reduced to 8 seconds. Instead of dispersing you into a bloody mist, Blood Mist consumes a nearby corpse to teleport you to the target location and grants Unstoppable for 3.0 seconds.
  • OverpowerBlood Mist grants 1 stack of Overpower every second.

  • HematolagniaBlood Wave becomes a Core Skill, has no Cooldown, but costs 50 Essence. Blood Wave conjures a shorter wave that deals 300% damage and no longer Knocks Back enemies.
  • Damage BonusBlood Wave deals 30%[x] increased damage while you are Fortified.
Physical Damage

Blood Lance

CoreBlood

Rank 1/15

Essence Cost: 15

Lucky Hit Chance: 50%

Throw a blood lance, dealing 130% to an enemy that ricochets to another enemy. Enemies hit are lanced for 3 seconds.

When Blood Lance hits an enemy, it deals damage to all other lanced enemies.

Modifiers

  • OverpowerBlood Lance consumes 2 stacks of Overpower to throw an additional lance, dealing 50% of normal damage.
  • FortifyBlood Lance Fortifies you for 4% of your Maximum Life ({x}) if it hits an enemy already lanced.
  • Festering WoundBlood Lance becomes a Darkness Skill and deals Shadow damage. Enemies hit are permanently lanced and the lance deals 80% Corrupting damage per second to them.
Physical Damage

Decrepify

CurseCorruption

Rank 15/15

Essence Cost: 10

Curse the target area. Enemies afflicted by Decrepify are Weakened and Slowed by 40.0% for 30 seconds.

Modifiers

  • ResolveLucky Hit: Enemies hit while afflicted with Decrepify have up to a 25% chance to grant 1 stack of Resolve.
  • Life TapDecrepify is also a Blood Skill, healing for 10.0% of your Maximum Life ({x}) whenever you hit an enemy afflicted with it, up to once a second. Enemies that die while afflicted with Decrepify have a 20% chance to form a Blood Orb.
  • Cooldown ReductionLucky Hit: Enemies hit while afflicted with Decrepify have up to a 15% chance to reduce a random active Cooldown by 1 second.

Bone Prison

MacabreBone

Rank 15/15

Cooldown: 15 seconds

Unearth a prison of bone with {x} Life that surrounds the target area for 6 seconds.

Modifiers

  • Essence GenerationCasting Bone Prison generates 50 Essence. Trapping a Boss generates an additional 25 Essence.
  • Life ImprisonmentBone Prison becomes a Blood Skill, casting the prison around you. While standing within it your Essence Generation and Cast Speed are increased by 20%, but it drains 5% of your Maximum Life every second.
  • ResolveBone Prison grants 1 stack of Resolve for each enemy trapped.

Corpse Generation

UpgradeReap

Rank 1/3

Reap forms a Corpse under the first enemy hit.

Essence Generation

UpgradeReap

Rank 1/3

Reap generates 2 additional Essence per enemy hit.

Cull The Weak

UpgradeReap

Rank 1/3

Reap becomes a Blood Skill that deals 62.5% Physical damage.

Reap will Execute enemies and has a 50% chance to form a Blood Orb if they are killed by it.

Critical Strike

UpgradeBlood Mist

Blood Rush

UpgradeBlood Mist

Rank 1/3

Blood Mist is now also a Mobility Skill and its Cooldown is reduced to 8 seconds.

Instead of dispersing you into a bloody mist, Blood Mist consumes a nearby corpse to teleport you to the target location and grants Unstoppable for 3.0 seconds.

Vulnerable and Slow

UpgradeBlood Mist

Rank 1/3

Blood Mist makes enemies Vulnerable and Slows them by 70% for 4 seconds.

Ferocity and Overpower

UpgradeIron Maiden

Rank 1/3

Blood Maiden

UpgradeIron Maiden

Rank 1/3

Iron Maiden is also a Blood Skill, causing enemies damaged by it to have a 5% chance to form a Blood Orb.

Casting Iron Maiden picks up 4 Blood Orbs in the target area and causes them to burst for 150% damage.

Execute and Fortify

UpgradeIron Maiden

Rank 1/3

Enemies afflicted with Iron Maiden will be Executed.

You are Fortified for 5% of your Maximum Life ({x}) when an enemy dies while afflicted with Iron Maiden.

Flame Surge

Core skillAldkin

Cooldown: 11 seconds

Fate: Aflame

Basic Attack: Fire Shot

Aldkin channels a cone of flame for 4 seconds, repeatedly dealing 80% Fire damage.

Aldkin's Mercenary Core Skill alters his Fate and Basic Attack.

Aldkin hurls a flaming bolt at an enemy, dealing 90% Fire damage and 55% Burning damage over 4 seconds.

Haunt

Core skillAldkin

Cooldown: 14 seconds

Fate: Forsaken

Basic Attack: Shadow Strike

Aldkin emits 3 ghostly souls at enemies, each Haunting their victims and dealing 90% Shadow damage over 10 seconds. If a target dies while being Haunted, its soul jumps to another target.

Aldkin's Mercenary Core Skill alters his Fate and Basic Attack.

Aldkin shoots a burst of shadow bolts at an enemy, each dealing 30% Shadow damage.

Storm of Fire

Iconic skillAldkin

Cooldown: 20 seconds

Aldkin rains a Fire Storm down from the sky that deals 300% Fire damage on impact and remains on the ground for 10 seconds. Every second, the Fire Storm Burns enemies within for 55% damage over 2.5 seconds.

Enemies hit by Fire Storm's impact or aftershocks have a 30% chance to be Stunned for 1.0 seconds.

Wave of Flame

Iconic skillAldkin

Cooldown: 25 seconds

Aldkin conjures a mass of flames forward, repeatedly dealing 550% Fire damage, Knocking Back enemies, and destroying small missiles.

Field of Languish

Iconic skillAldkin

Cooldown: 20 seconds

Aldkin desiccates an area for 6 seconds, Slowing enemies within by 40% and reducing their damage dealt by 20%.

Chain of Souls

Iconic skillAldkin

Cooldown: 21 seconds

Aldkin chains up to 10 enemies to himself, Tethering to them and dealing 84% Shadow damage over 2.5 seconds.

When the chains expire, they deal 35% Shadow damage and Stun their victims for 2.5 seconds.

Terrify

PassiveAldkin

Hits of Aldkin's Haunt have a 30% chance to inflict Vulnerable on enemies for 4 seconds.

Exhaustion

PassiveAldkin

Aldkin's Shadow damage has a 10% chance to Daze enemies for 2 seconds.

Paranoia

PassiveAldkin

Lucky Hit: Attacks against Languishing enemies have up to a 20% chance to Daze them for 1.0 seconds.

Languishing enemies take 15%[x] increased damage from you.

Condemned

PassiveAldkin

You instantly kill Languishing enemies with less than 40% Life. Does not work on Elites.

Shared Pain

PassiveAldkin

Aldkin's Chain of Souls Cooldown is reduced by 1.5 seconds when a chained target dies.

Amplified Suffering

PassiveAldkin

Damaging a Soul Chained enemy detonates the chain early, dealing 50% Shadow damage around them.

Covered in Ash

PassiveAldkin

Hits of Aldkin's Flame Surge Slow enemies by 20% and deal an additional 60% Burning damage over 3 seconds.

Raging Violence

PassiveAldkin

Allies gain 15%[+] Critical Strike Chance against enemies affected by Flame Surge.

Ember's Gift

PassiveAldkin

You restore 33 Resource per second while inside Aldkin's Fire Storm.

Eradication

PassiveAldkin

Enemies killed within Aldkin's Fire Storm explode for heavy Fire damage.

Raging Havoc

PassiveAldkin

Enemies damaged by Aldkin's Wave of Flame take 15%[x] increased Damage Over Time for 4 seconds.

Burning Chaos

PassiveAldkin

Aldkin's Wave of Flame Cooldown resets when you cast an Ultimate Skill.
